prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear passenger door and quarter panel show deep crushing consistent with a side impact at an intersection, and the pattern of deformation lines up with the account given of how the collision happened. The intrusion reaches the B-pillar trim, so replacing the door, reinforcing the pillar, and refinishing the panel is the proper plan. Labor hours run a little high for this scope, and I have noted a modest adjustment for the body technician's time. The invoices on file show no duplicated line items. Nothing in the vehicle history points to earlier damage in this area.
